BAN-PLAYFAIR-INTER.reason: False positive from client case-study DATA, not this site's fonts: src/data/clients.ts records the typefaces each client site actually uses (Andy's = Playfair Display, Sea Cave = Inter) for the /work type panels. This site's own stack is JetBrains Mono + Schibsted Grotesk + Hanken Grotesk (src/app/layout.tsx).

SHOT-NEEDS-DEVICE-FRAME.reason: The file flagged IS the device frame. src/components/ui/SafariPhone.tsx draws an iPhone 16 Pro in Safari around a capture — bezel, corner radius, Dynamic Island, toolbars — so the check fires on the one file that exists to satisfy it. Every bare capture on this site goes through it or through DeviceDuo.
SHOT-NEEDS-DEVICE-FRAME.approvedBy: pre-ship pass before the case-study deploy

A11Y-OPACITY-DIMS-TEXT.reason: Not text. src/app/globals.css:182 is the page's film grain — `position: fixed; inset: 0; pointer-events: none` with a fractalNoise SVG at opacity 0.025. It has no glyphs in it and nothing reads through it as type, so the blended-contrast rule the check enforces has no subject. The site's actual text contrast is unaffected by this layer.
A11Y-OPACITY-DIMS-TEXT.approvedBy: pre-ship pass before the case-study deploy

A11Y-FOCUS-RING-IS-A-FILL.reason: The ring and the fill never meet. The only place --cs-mark paints a background in src/app/case-study.css is a 0.4rem decorative dot inside .cs-flow__row (L743); the focus ring the check flags is on .cs-rail__item, a different element in a different component, sitting on --cs-ground paper where --cs-mark measures 4.22:1 and clears the 3:1 focus-indicator floor of WCAG 2.4.11. The check pattern-matches a token used as both without testing whether a ring ever lands on that fill. The real contrast failure it sat next to was fixed rather than excepted: .cs-rail__n was 10px bold at 4.21:1 and now uses --cs-mark-ink (#6b47f0, 5.18:1).

CONTROL-HEIGHT-OFF-SCALE.reason: Not a control. src/components/layout/LandingPageHeader.tsx:9 is the header bar's inner row — `mx-auto flex h-14 max-w-7xl items-center px-5` — a layout container holding one logo link, and h-14 is the bar's height, not a control's. The check reads `h-` plus `px-` as a padded control. This project also defines no --control-h scale in globals.css, so the prescribed fix has nothing to point at; standing up one to satisfy a false positive would be inventing a design system for a single header.
